editorial: Forget the political intrigue and buckle up for a high-octane siege on wheels. You get a claustrophobic yet explosive power trip that transforms a presidential limo into a sentient weapon of war. Renny Harlin delivers pure, unadulterated carnage through breathtaking practical stunts and relentless pacing. You will love this if you crave mindless, adrenaline-fueled spectacle over a complex plot. It is a loud, metallic symphony of destruction that demands the biggest screen possible.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of high-concept action and vehicular mayhem.
